as_told.title: Westall school mass sighting and landing

plain: Westall is a suburb in Australia, and this story concerns a sighting there in 1966 near a school. A UFO documentary filmmaker, James Fox, says he went there to investigate what he calls a landing case from the 1960s and met witnesses who told him they had been going at it for 50 years. If true, it would be a craft seen by a large crowd in broad daylight. A debater named Merrick says 200 or 300 students and a teacher, depending on the account, saw a silver disc tilted on its side that then took off at 1,000 miles per hour, though he does not mention a landing. Fox, in another episode, puts the witnesses at 300-plus, watching the disc zip around the sky, and credits two researchers, Shane Ryan and James Rigney. A guest named Karl Nell brings it up as a near-identical match to another school sighting. All of this is told on the podcast of a host, Jesse Michels.
